''See also: [[Chronicler Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Chroniclers]] are members of the [[Guild of Witnesses]], an organization responsible for recording and distributing impartial accounts of significant [[Imperial]] history. They function as the keepers of knowledge, tasked with witnessing events and ensuring their accurate preservation for others. In practice, [[Chroniclers]] often work in pairs with a [[Silent One]], who serves as their bodyguard and protector. A defining characteristic of a Chronicler is the belt of alchemically treated wax candles they carry. By burning these candles, a Chronicler can relive their own memories to ensure infallible recollection of the events they have witnessed. While some may use their position and access to [[Imperial]] resources for personal or political agendas, the role is fundamentally centered on the preservation of history and the maintenance of [[Imperial]] stability through information.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|On the ship}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[Naberius Clayborn]], known as the Chronicler, is an impressively skilled [[Reader]] and a character aboard the ship.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c3">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c9">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c23">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 23</ref> He possesses knowledge of a unique treasure belonging to the Emperor that was never entrusted to anyone else.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c5">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 5</ref> After staggering to his feet while clutching the [[Heart of Nakothi]], he wailed upon losing the object.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c11">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c12">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 12</ref> While present at the table, he is a person who may hold control over [[Bliss of the Blackwatch{{!}}Bliss]] and might even deserve the throne if it results in a sentence of death and insanity.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c14">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c16">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 16</ref> Additionally, a Chronicler is someone capable of writing notes with great speed.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c18">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 18</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The role of Chronicler is a position held by the Heads of the [[Guild of Witnesses{{!}}Witness’ Guild]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 6</ref> To facilitate memory recollection, these individuals carry candles that have been treated with alchemy to store [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6" />}}
